purpose: Replace existence lookup with one common calculable stability target for the frozen v0.7 ligand-family panel.

model_roles.M0: parity-only admission; predicts all listed higher-coordination parents
model_roles.M1: v0.5 shell gate; rejects second-period N/O higher-coordination parents and admits P/As/S/Se parents
model_roles.M2: reserved name for M1 plus the independent conventional energetic admission control; M2 is not a new Hamiltonian or fitted energy term

energy_target.positive_label: parent and both products are harmonic local minima under one identical method policy AND delta_E_pair > frozen tolerance
energy_target.negative_label: parent is not a local minimum OR parent is a local minimum and delta_E_pair < -frozen tolerance
energy_target.unresolved: missing energy/Hessian, method-policy mismatch, product not a local minimum, or near-degeneracy within tolerance

method_policy.rule: Before the first energy record is admitted, create one immutable method-policy amendment fixing method, basis, relativistic treatment, dispersion, environment, geometry optimization, Hessian policy, energy kind, charge, and multiplicity policy for the full panel.
method_policy.anti_fit: The method policy may not be selected after inspecting candidate-specific energy results.

scoring.primary: balanced accuracy on resolved held-out energy labels if both classes are present
secondary: continuous delta_E_pair distribution by model class
scoring.unknowns: retained visibly and excluded from the accuracy denominator

primary_methodology_context.note: High-level SFn study reports sequential dissociation energies and explicitly follows structural/electronic reorganization across the series.
Coupled-cluster thermochemistry study emphasizes that adiabatic bond dissociation energies include product reorganization and can differ strongly between sequential ligand-loss steps.

anti_fit_rules: Do not change pair-loss channels after energy results are visible.
Do not substitute a different decomposition product for one candidate only.
Do not convert missing or unconverged calculations into negative labels.
Do not mix method/basis/relativistic/environment policies inside one scored panel.
Do not promote the structural relation model merely because conventional quantum chemistry supplies the correct energy label.
